crackers.line: The fireworks I fire will crack, and split crackers
stanza: So you can vote “Yes I Can!” (I'm not lightskinned!), for me in 2016
I’m a real American, just don’t expect me to rep
That red, white and blue, anytime soon because
The fireworks I fire will crack, and split crackers
Down to the middle, like Malcolm or Muniz, to be frank-eeeehh
And go krack-krack..... krack-krack-krack-ka-BOOM, that fire works though all I…
Or I’ll make them waters-work, I’m not sweet, like a maple leaf

crackers.songTitle: (Don’t Worry) If There’s a Hell Below, We’re All Going to Go
